local_recovery_history: The default shell uses Python 3.13 and an old editable provider, so validation used existing compatible Python 3.14 prefixes.

The small prepared-provider benchmark prefix cannot collect a full suite without unrelated backends; initial collection fails for OpenMM, and later a borrowed CF module lacks its native UDUNITS library. Full prepared source validation instead uses the complete scientific Python 3.14 base with the same provider source.
An expanded source selection installer and one temporary profile-file write encountered full disk. Only task-created pip/bootstrap/build copies were cleaned; the exact installer rerun passed.

A first benchmark pass is excluded as a pilot; final retained pairs run without simultaneous task tests and use the final tuple-compatible wheel. Unrelated process load and ordinary-control variation remain measurement limitations.
limits: Performance is a local warmed comparison with the controlled prepared provider at cfb5140, not qualification of Ackredit writer change bcbb6d8.
All seven raw samples per case are retained for three alternating independent-process pairs; ordinary controls drift, so no general speedup percentage is claimed.
Cold imports/activation/first-use planning and non-pilot backends are outside measured scope.
